name_reason: Convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with no address residue. 'attack_action_dispatch' accurately conveys 'dispatch an enemy-AI offensive action'; the AI/battle domain is established by the sole caller fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher and the fd2_ai_score_*/fd2_execute_ai_* callees. A marginally more precise name (e.g. fd2_ai_dispatch_best_action) is conceivable but the rename is low value and not clearly warranted; keep to avoid churn across protos.h/call sites.
purpose: Enemy-AI offensive action selector: scores physical/spell/item candidates, then executes the highest-scoring one (returns 1 if dispatched, 0 if all scores below the usefulness threshold 6).
logic_summary: Calls the fd2_ai_score_* trio (physical, offensive spell, item) which each write their own best-candidate result globals. Computes tie_break = caster pCombat_aux_block[0xD] & 0x40 (set forces physical) and shared_raw = caster wAP - best_physical_target wDP. If all three best scores < 6, return 0. Otherwise pick the strict-max category: phys>spell && phys>item -> physical; spell>phys && spell>=item -> spell; item>phys && item>spell -> item. Ties: phys==spell>item -> spell if best_spell_id<0xb and shared_raw<=spell.base_damage(*(uint16*)spell_effect_entry), or if best_spell_id>=0xb and tie_break==0, else physical; phys==item>spell -> item if tie_break==0 else physical; remaining ties fall through to no-op. After dispatch set data_fd2_battle_anim_phase=0 and return 1.

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-char array index of the acting enemy; indexes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (reads pCombat_aux_block[0xD] and wAP) and is forwarded to every score/execute callee.
params.reason: Accurately names the caster index; no address residue; matches sibling functions.

params.name: ctx_flag
params.semantics: Turn/team context flag passed through verbatim from caller (fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher's team arg) to all fd2_ai_score_* and fd2_execute_ai_* callees; downstream it gates AOE-flag derivation (ctx_flag==0 path) in the execute functions.
params.reason: Name matches the same parameter in fd2_execute_ai_offensive_spell / fd2_execute_ai_item_use; conveys an opaque pass-through context flag; no address residue.

returns.semantics: 1 if an action (physical/spell/item, or a recognized no-op tie) was dispatched; 0 if all three best scores < 6 (AI found nothing useful, caller should fall back to movement).

comment_original_issue: Original src comment ('Score phys/spell/item, pick best, execute winner. Returns 1 if action executed, 0 if all scores < 6.') was correct and concise but omitted the non-obvious tie-break behavior (pCombat_aux_block[0xD] & 0x40 forces physical; phys==spell low-id branch compares spell base damage vs wAP-wDP) and the ctx_flag pass-through.
notes: Param semantics confirmed via caller fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher (param_1=char_idx, param_2=team forwarded unchanged) and via downstream use in fd2_execute_ai_offensive_spell/fd2_execute_ai_item_use (ctx_flag==0 gates AOE flag). Spell-damage offset-0 reading cross-checked against fd2_score_spell_candidate/fd2_score_item_candidate (*(uint16*)spell_effect_entry = spell base damage). Struct offsets consistent: pCombat_aux_block @ +0x27 (so [0xD]=+0x34), wAP @ +0x48, wDP @ +0x4A. Plate is detailed and consistent with the refined understanding; left unchanged. No logic/equivalence concerns: source is a faithful structured rendering of the decompile (the spell-tie low-id false branch falls through to physical, matching the decompile's fall-through to the bottom physical call).
